modules.name: DreamRack
modules.description: Every jack tells you what it is without reading the panel: colour for the kind of signal, and a ring that says input or output — the same on every module, whoever wrote it. Cables take the colour of where they go, with dashes crawling along them, so there is never a moment wondering which way a signal is flowing. Trace one cable through a tangle. Clip oscilloscopes and signal sources straight onto a terminal. You choose which of the features you want, with switches on the panel.
